R269.note: session_regenerate_id() before the authenticated writes closes fixation; the explanation misstates that the old session data is discarded (with delete_old_session=false the old ID stays valid but never becomes authenticated), which does not affect the fix.

R270.note: gob decodes into a narrow DTO (gob ignores stream fields absent from the receiver) and IsAdmin is set server-side; Command/Priority still reach runJob per the contract.

R271.note: PasswordEncoder.matches() against the stored hash closes the bypass; the new PasswordEncoder constructor dependency and BadCredentialsException mapping are stated in the write-up and block no legitimate login.

R272.note: snprintf with return check closes the overflow, but entries longer than 63 bytes (~39 bytes of username+message after the timestamp) are now rejected with -1 instead of logged - a new restriction on unbounded inputs, stated in the write-up; fprintf to the file or a sized heap buffer would have preserved the contract.

R273.note: GetFullPath plus separator-terminated prefix check contains the path; residual nit is the OrdinalIgnoreCase comparison, which on a case-sensitive filesystem would accept a sibling directory differing only in case, and the added 404/403 exception mapping is stated and blocks no legitimate reads.

R274.note: Branches swapped so admins get Order::all() and non-admins get only their own orders, exactly per the contract.

R275.note: Role check via AuthenticationStateProvider inside the handler guards the delete regardless of how it is invoked; admins see no change.

R276.note: setSecure(true) closes the finding; the unchanged response text still says 'secure flag set to: false', now inaccurate but not a behaviour change.

R277.note: Moving the mapping to POST puts it under CsrfFilter, but the existing 'delete my account' link the comment describes now gets 405 and the write-up claims functionality is preserved rather than stating the settings page must switch to a token-bearing form.

R278.note: Parameterized sqlx Select with the value as a bind argument; unused fmt import removed; ? bindvar assumes a MySQL/SQLite-style driver, same as the case implies.

R279.note: Length-prefixed RESP bulk strings make embedded CRLF data rather than framing; verified in a scratch PowerShell run that Encoding.ASCII byte count equals string Length even for surrogate pairs, so the char-count length prefix stays consistent (non-ASCII lossy replacement was pre-existing).

R280.note: Prefix check now requires uploadsDir followed by a separator, blocking the uploads-backup sibling; files under the directory still serve as before.

R281.note: basename() leaves no separator to escape the notes directory, and the header contract says names are flat files in that directory; stripping rather than rejecting is stated openly, though the retained containment check is now dead code.

R282.note: AES/GCM/NoPadding with a fresh SecureRandom IV and 128-bit tag; the IV-prefixed Base64 layout the key holder must parse is stated plainly and the 400 path is untouched.

R283.note: Build fails: FilterInfo has serialClass(), not getClassName(), so the fix does not compile and the application stops building without the write-up saying so; even corrected, the lambda would NPE on null serialClass and a strict RestoredSession-only allowlist needs String/UNDECIDED handling.

R284.note: Escaping with {{ }} closes the XSS, but for a field named descriptionHtml any supported rich-text formatting now renders as literal tags; the write-up only conditionally mentions a presenter-side sanitizer as the alternative rather than applying it.
